events.verdict: Hardaway Jr.'s (DET) right arm momentarily brushes Bane's (MEM) off-arm as Bane ends his drive and the contact on the play is marginal.
Bane's (MEM) off-arm comes out slightly as he ends his drive and the contact with Hardaway Jr. (DET) is marginal.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) legally contests Bane's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) does not establish himself in a legal guarding position prior to contact occurring with Cunningham (DET), which affects his SQBR with the ball.
Bane (MEM) moves towards the center of the paint and his left hand lightly brushes Stewart's (DET) front during his layup attempt. The contact during the play is marginal.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) moves towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Stewart (DET) during his shot attempt in the paint.
Cunningham (DET) grasps and quickly releases the side of Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jersey and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Edey (MEM) releases the ball prior to his left heel coming down onto the baseline and out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Schroder (DET) makes marginal contact with Bane's (MEM) arm, during the rebounding.
Stewart (DET) and Edey (MEM) engage and disengage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Bane (MEM) and Schroder (DET) come together while in the air while pursuing the loose ball. The contact on the play is marginal and both players lose their balance as they return to the ground.

Wells (MEM) legally contest Hardaway Jr.'s (DET) jump shot attempt. The contact with Hardaway Jr.'s left arm after the release is considered marginal and Hardaway Jr. appears to lose his balance on his own accord as he steps backwards into the spectator stands.
Schroder (DET) legally contests Bane's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) legally contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

Beasley's (DET) left arm comes forward as he is firming up in a legal guarding position and marginal contact occurs with Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) head/face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) and Beasley (DET) come together at the same spot on the floor as Pippen Jr. begins his drive and the resulting contact is marginal.

Replay review of the offensive foul called on Pippen Jr. (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Cunningham (DET) extends his hand into Pippen Jr.'s chest, which affects his SQBR during his drive into the paint. The illegal contact initiated by Cunningham precedes Pippen Jr. raising his off-arm up and coming into contact with Cunningham's arm. A defensive foul is correctly assessed to Cunningham.
Bane (MEM) moves into and through Schroder's (DET) space, dislodging the offensive player from his legal screening position.
Thompson (DET) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) engage during the inbound play and the contact is marginal.

Five seconds elapses after Aldama (MEM) receives the ball from the official and prior to Aldama requesting a timeout. A five-second violation is correctly called and possession is properly awarded to Detroit.
After the ball is established in the frontcourt by Stewart (DET) he passes the ball backwards to Cunningham (DET), who has failed to establishes a positive frontcourt position.

Wells (MEM) brings his right hand directly to the ball and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Cunningham (DET). Wells' contact with the ball is simultaneous to slight brush contact with Cunningham's head/face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Bane (MEM). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Detroit.
Cunningham (DET) releases the ball prior to five seconds elapsing after receiving the ball from the game official.
Edey (MEM) cleanly blocks Beasley's (DET) layup attempt in the paint and avoids making any illegal contact with the offensive player.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) legally contests Schroder's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Beasley (DET) commits a take foul on Wells (MEM).
